input.title: Archive context: Maximum call stack exceeded
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - m
    - x
- b
  - m
    - y
  - n
```

1. Activate context view on `a/m`. 
2. Archive `a/m~/b`. 

## Current Behavior

Maximum call stack exceeded. 

## Expected Behavior

`b/m` should be archived.
